CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTPARTICIPATION_LNS
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation AS (
SELECT
	BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,NULL AS CustomerId
	,BLA.START_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BLA.END_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
	,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
	,NULL AS LinkCode
	,BLA.DEL_FLG AS DeletedIndicator
	,BLA.GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
	,BLA.PROFIT_CERT_FLG AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
	,BLA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG AS VerifiedIndicator
	,BLA.MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
	,BLA.CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
	,BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM AS SerialNumber
	,BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
	,BLA.CUST_ID AS CoreCustomerId
	,BLA.CUST_RELTN_CODE AS CustomerRelationCode
	,BLA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BLA.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BLAD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN_DELTA BLAD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN BLA ON BLAD.ACID = BLA.ACID AND BLAD.BANK_ID = BLA.BANK_ID AND BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM = BLAD.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM AND BLA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BLA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM = '001' --ADDED FOR DUPE
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLA.ACID = BLG.ACID AND BLA.ISLATEST = 1  

)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,DeletedIndicator
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CoreCustomerId
,CustomerRelationCode
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,DeletedIndicator
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CoreCustomerId
,CustomerRelationCode
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'  AND (PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000')
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR TGT.PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000'



---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,LinkCode
,DeletedIndicator
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CoreCustomerId
,CustomerRelationCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,NULL AS CustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,NULL AS LinkCode
,SRC.DeletedIndicator AS DeletedIndicator
,SRC.GuarantorLiabilityPercentage AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,SRC.ProfitCertificateIndicator AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
,SRC.VerifiedIndicator AS VerifiedIndicator
,SRC.MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,SRC.ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SRC.SerialNumber AS SerialNumber
,SRC.RelatedPartyAllowedAmount AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,SRC.CoreCustomerId AS CoreCustomerId
,SRC.CustomerRelationCode AS CustomerRelationCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,LinkCode
,DeletedIndicator
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CoreCustomerId
,CustomerRelationCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,NULL AS CustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,NULL AS LinkCode
,DeletedIndicator AS DeletedIndicator
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,ProfitCertificateIndicator AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator AS VerifiedIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber AS SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CoreCustomerId AS CoreCustomerId
,CustomerRelationCode AS CustomerRelationCode
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;

END
